description: Source code for xutils.c, part of the LibXDiff library, including utility functions for file diffing, memory management, and hashing.

methods.name: xdl_bogosqrt
methods.description: Calculates an integer approximation of the square root using bit shifts.

methods.name: xdl_emit_diffrec
methods.description: Outputs a diff record with optional newline at end.

methods.name: xdl_mmfile_first
methods.description: Returns pointer to first data in mmfile and sets size.

methods.name: xdl_cha_free
methods.description: Frees all nodes in a chastore_t.

methods.name: xdl_cha_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new node in the chastore_t.

methods.name: xdl_guess_lines
methods.description: Estimates number of lines in a file based on sample.

methods.name: xdl_blankline
methods.description: Checks if a line is blank or whitespace only based on flags.

methods.name: ends_with_optional_cr
methods.description: Checks if a line ends with an optional CR before newline.

methods.name: xdl_recmatch
methods.description: Compares two lines with whitespace and CR ignoring options.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace
methods.description: Hashes a record with whitespace handling based on flags.

methods.name: xdl_hash_record_verbatim
methods.description: Hashes a record verbatim, processing two characters at a time.

methods.name: xdl_hashbits
methods.description: Calculates number of bits needed for hash table size.

methods.name: xdl_num_out
methods.description: Converts a long integer to string.

methods.name: xdl_format_hunk_hdr
methods.description: Formats a diff hunk header line.

methods.name: xdl_emit_hunk_hdr
methods.description: Emits a diff hunk header, either formatted or via callback.

methods.name: xdl_fall_back_diff
methods.description: Performs a fallback diff on file segments, used in Git.

methods.name: xdl_alloc_grow_helper
methods.description: Helper for growing allocated memory with reallocation.
